# Agent Plugins schemas (vendored)

Copies of the published Agent Plugins 1.0.0 JSON Schemas, fetched on 2026-10-07 from:

- https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json
- https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/mcp.schema.json

`tests/mcp-gateway.test.mjs` validates the portable `plugin.json` and `mcp.json` of `plugins/preset-mcp-skills` against them offline (no network). Refresh them from the URLs above if the schema version changes.
